subject: Offer discussion: Samira Khan — competing offer & decision deadline
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@gmail.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Offer update / quick question

Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for the time with Marissa and the team — I really enjoyed the loop and am excited about the role. I wanted to be transparent: I received a competing offer from Horizon Data yesterday. The Horizon package is materially higher on base and includes a larger sign-on. They asked for a decision by Tuesday EOD Pacific (July 20).

I prefer Redwood based on the team and the technical fit, but I need to close the gap to make it viable. Can you let me know if Redwood would be willing to revisit base and sign-on (or equity) before that deadline? Happy to share the Horizon offer if that helps.

Attaching my CV and the Horizon offer PDF for reference.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
(415) 555-0182

Attachment stubs: Samira_CV.pdf, Horizon_Offer.pdf

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-18T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Offer update / quick question

Forwarding Samira's note — she just shared a competing offer and has a hard deadline: Tue 7/20 EOD PT.

Quick context: San Francisco-based senior ML infra candidate (REQ-1342). We previously extended the standard package: base $185k, sign-on $20k, ~0.5% equity. Candidate is asking for footprint match.

Can we escalate and get a steer on whether we can make a competitive counter (base bump and sign-on or equity refresh)? If we need a formal comp-band exception, please advise who needs to approve and any limits. I can draft the counter once we have numbers.

— Aisha

On Fri, Jul 18, 2026 at 9:12 AM Samira Khan <samira.khan@gmail.com> wrote:
> Hi Aisha,
> 
> Thanks again for the time with Marissa and the team...

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-18T10:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Offer update / quick question

Thanks for the heads up — two quick suggestions: 1) escalate comp-band exception (we're at the top of band for Senior) and 2) offer a structured counter: raise base to $200k + $30k sign-on, bump equity to ~0.7% with 25% of grant up-front refresh in 12 months. That should be defensible vs. Horizon without breaking L4/L5 budgeting if Marissa signs off.

Approval flow: hiring manager ok -> comp-band exception signoff (Karthik) -> GC/finance review if sign-on exceeds $25k? (we can loop in finance but for speed Karthik can approve a one-time exception up to $30k).

If everyone agrees I can draft the offer PDF and the DocuSign packet; Aisha can send it to Samira with a 48-hour decision window.

— Lauren (Senior Recruiter)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-18T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Offer update / quick question

I'm comfortable stretching the comp band for this candidate given the quality of the loop and the infra need. I want the counter to be clean and final — don't give multiple back-and-forths. Proposed if we can: base $200k, sign-on $30k, equity 0.7% (IS), standard vesting. If we must, we can also add a one-time relocation/remote-stipend of $5k.

Marissa
Hiring Manager, ML Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-18T17:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Offer update / quick question

Ok to approve a one-time comp-band exception for REQ-1342 to the numbers Marissa proposed. Sign-on up to $30k is fine; base to $200k and equity ~0.7% is acceptable given the urgency and strategic priority. Finance should be informed but this does not need a separate exec review.

I'll mark the req and note the exception in the approval sheet. Please proceed — a single final offer is best.

— Karthik (Head of Talent)

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@gmail.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-19T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Revised offer — Redwood Inference (REQ-1342)

Hi Samira,

Thanks for sharing the update and for your transparency — we really appreciated meeting you. Per the team's approval, please find our revised offer attached. Highlights: base $200,000, one-time sign-on $30,000, equity ~0.7% IS, standard 4-year vesting with 1-year cliff. We also included a $5,000 one-time remote/relocation stipend per Marissa's note.

This offer is being sent as a single, final counter to match the timelines you shared. We'd like to give you until Tuesday, July 21 11:59 AM PT to confirm acceptance to accommodate the deadline you mentioned. If you need a shorter window we can accommodate — please let me know.

Attachment: offer_Samira_v2.pdf (official offer packet + DocuSign link below)
DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/some/docid/abc123

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Recruiter, Redwood Inference
aisha_rahman@redwood.com

Attachment stubs: offer_Samira_v2.pdf

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@gmail.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-20T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Revised offer — Redwood Inference (REQ-1342)

Aisha — thanks so much for the swift turnaround and for the clear, final offer. I appreciate the improved structure; Redwood remains my top choice. Two quick asks before I sign: would the team consider shifting 0.05% from the initial equity grant into a 1-year refresh target (so headline stays ~0.7% but 0.55% upfront + 0.15% performance refresh in 12 months)? Also, is there any flexibility to move the DocuSign expiration to EOD Tuesday PT (that's what Horizon gave me) — I know you offered midday Tue which is fine but aligning with the other offer would help.

If those two items are feasible I can sign immediately. I understand if the equity structure needs legal/comp team review — happy to accept if we get written confirmation on the refresh schedule.

Best,
Samira
(415) 555-0182
